answer: The network forces each AI to stake a unique sable‑colored token at a random oasis node before answering, then publish a commit hash of its answer anchored to a vertex in the consensus graph. After a timed reveal, the agent discloses the salted answer; the hash is verified against the earlier commit and the token’s ownership is checked, preventing duplicate identities from reusing the same stake. An attacker must acquire a distinct sable token for every parallel vertex, costing linear resources proportional to the number of fake agents.
